S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.

subtypes.Chronic Fatigue: Fatigue that persists for a long period even after adequate rest.
subtypes.Physical Fatigue: A state of physical exhaustion where the body feels heavy and easily tires even from minor activities.
subtypes.Mental Fatigue: A state where fatigue accumulates rapidly during the process of thinking or concentrating.
subtypes.Loss of Energy: Difficulty performing daily activities due to a decline in energy and vitality.

S056.name: Excessive_Anxiety_Worry
S056.description: Excessive anxiety and worry (expectant apprehension) occurring persistently about a number of events or activities.

subtypes.Chronic Worry: Worry occurs more days than not for at least 6 months.
subtypes.Generalized Worry: Worry is not confined to specific topics but spreads to various domains like work, school, family, and finances.
subtypes.Catastrophizing: Jumping to conclusions that minor mistakes or events will lead to irreversible disasters.
subtypes.Intolerance of Uncertainty: Unable to tolerate future uncertainty, trapped in 'what if' questions.

S057.name: Uncontrollable_Worry
S057.description: The subjective experience of finding it difficult to stop or control the worry.

subtypes.Failure to Control: Unable to regulate worry despite efforts to stop or distract oneself.
subtypes.Intrusive Worry: Worries suddenly intrude into the mind and interfere with focus while doing other tasks.
subtypes.Chaining of Worry: One worry triggers another in a chain reaction, escalating to catastrophic thoughts.

S058.name: Restlessness_Tension
S058.description: Restlessness, or feeling keyed up or on edge.

subtypes.Feeling Keyed Up: Feeling anxious and wound up like a spring, unable to stay still.
subtypes.Physical Tension: The entire body feels stiff and tense, unable to relax.
subtypes.Nervousness: Nerves are on edge, being startled easily by minor sounds or stimuli.

S061.name: Muscle_Tension
S061.description: A state where muscles are continuously tense, stiff, and accompanied by discomfort.

subtypes.Neck and Shoulder Tension: Muscles in the shoulders and back of the neck are knotted and stiff, causing pain or headaches.
subtypes.Jaw Tension: Clenching teeth or tension in the jaw causing jaw pain or headaches.
subtypes.Generalized Muscle Aches: Muscles all over the body, including back, arms, and legs, are stiff, painful, and easily fatigued.
subtypes.Chronic Stiffness: Muscles remain in a constant state of tension and do not relax.

patient_info.stressor_event: Major change in living condition (new home, remodeling, deterioration of neighborhood or home)
patient_info.stressor: Ronny’s orderly home life was disrupted when a winter pipe burst forced months of remodeling, temporary room changes, contractor schedules, and unexpected expenses during the busiest stretch of the school year. At first he responded by making spreadsheets and contingency plans, but over the next 7 months the worry spread from the renovation to lesson pacing, robotics club deadlines, theater rehearsals, baseball commitments, and whether he was letting his family down. His difficulty turning the worry off, persistent fatigue, restlessness, and muscle tension began to interfere with teaching preparation and led him to scale back community-theater responsibilities he normally handled well. He finally sought psychiatric care after his primary care physician, seeing no simple medical explanation for his ongoing exhaustion and tension, recommended an anxiety evaluation through the school district’s health plan.

S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.
S029.manifestation: By the time the last bell rings I feel wrung out in a way that a decent night's sleep or a quiet Sunday doesn't really fix, and even grading a short stack of quizzes feels like pushing through mud.

S056.name: Excessive_Anxiety_Worry
S056.description: Excessive anxiety and worry (expectant apprehension) occurring persistently about a number of events or activities.
S056.manifestation: My mind keeps jumping from whether the contractors missed something in the house to whether my lesson plans are slipping, whether the robotics kids are behind, and whether I'm disappointing my wife and family by not keeping everything under control.

S057.name: Uncontrollable_Worry
S057.description: The subjective experience of finding it difficult to stop or control the worry.
S057.manifestation: I can tell myself to stop and focus on the class in front of me, but one small thought—like a late invoice or a student falling behind—sets off a whole chain of what-ifs that I can't shut down.

S058.name: Restlessness_Tension
S058.description: Restlessness, or feeling keyed up or on edge.
S058.manifestation: I feel wound up most of the day, like I'm waiting for something else to go wrong, and I catch myself pacing around the classroom or checking my phone for messages from the contractor between periods.

S061.name: Muscle_Tension
S061.description: A state where muscles are continuously tense, stiff, and accompanied by discomfort.
S061.manifestation: What finally made me come in is that my neck, shoulders, and jaw are tight almost all the time now, like I'm bracing for bad news even when I'm just sitting at my desk or trying to watch TV at night.

functional_impairment.name: Functional Impairment
functional_impairment.manifestation: I've started falling behind on lesson prep and grading, and I gave up parts of the community-theater work I usually manage because I couldn't keep up with all of it anymore.

duration.name: Duration
duration.manifestation: This has been going on for about seven months, since the pipe burst and the remodeling threw the house into chaos.
